package.name: soslab_gl5_driver
package.description: SOSLAB GL-5 lidar driver, packaged as a PREBUILT aarch64 binary. The original source was lost; this wraps the last known-good build (RUNPATH patched to $ORIGIN so libLidar_x64_release.so ships alongside). Publishes /soslab/pointcloud (sensor_msgs/PointCloud2, frame 'laser').
